text: Is it? Do tell me what is good about it.
Oh, hello... I am glad you are here. Sorry, I am not very good at this.
Well. I did wonder. Now then.
I'm fine, thank you. And you?
It's rather good, isn't it — the weather, I mean.
You came all the way from Paris?
Good day, sir. Lord, what a morning.
